source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 33 (PDF 247-261), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 33 (Water) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Which of the following is a role of water mentioned for plants?
(Paudon ke liye pani ka kaun sa kirdar bayan kiya gaya hai?)

options.text: yeh unhein nitrogen gas deta hai
yeh un ke patton se oxygen nikal deta hai
yeh un ki mitti ko impermeable bana deta hai
yeh unhein photosynthesis karne deta hai

blocks.explanation: Pani paudon ko photosynthesis karne deta hai aur fasal ugane mein madad se zaraat (agriculture) ko sahara deta hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: It allows plants to perform photosynthesis and supports agriculture

blocks.prompt:
2 In nature, water recharges:
(Qudrat mein pani kis ko dobara bharta (recharge karta) hai?)

options.text: zer-e-zameen ke pani ke zakhire (underground reservoirs)

blocks.explanation: Pani zameen ko shakal deta hai, climate (mausami nizam) mein tawazun rakhta hai aur zer-e-zameen ke zakhire (underground reservoirs) bharta hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: In nature, water shapes the land, maintains a balance in the climate, and recharges underground reservoirs

blocks.prompt:
3 The unique properties of water that matter for life and the environment arise mainly because the H₂O molecule is:
(Zindagi aur mahol ke liye pani ki munfarid khususiyaat zyada tar is wajah se hain ke H₂O molecule:)
blocks.explanation: Pani ka molecule permanent dipole (mustaqil do-qutbi) hai; yehi polarity pani ko munfarid khususiyaat deti hai (33.1).

book_ref.quote: The water molecule (H₂O) is a permanent dipole.

blocks.prompt:
4 Hydrogen bonds form between water molecules because of:
(Pani ke molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds kis wajah se bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pani ke molecule ki polarity ki wajah se molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds bante hain (33.1 i).

book_ref.quote: The polarity of the water molecule results in the formation of hydrogen bonds

blocks.prompt:
5 Hydrogen bonding gives water:
(Hydrogen bonding pani ko kya deti hai?)

options.text: zyada specific heat capacity aur zyada heat of vaporisation
kam specific heat capacity aur kam heat of vaporisation
zyada specific heat capacity magar kam heat of vaporisation
kam boiling point aur zyada volatility

blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bonding pani ko zyada specific heat capacity aur zyada heat of vaporisation deti hai (33.1 i).

book_ref.quote: Hydrogen bonding gives water a high specific heat capacity and high heat of vaporisation.

blocks.prompt:
6 Large bodies of water such as lakes and seas are described as thermally stable. This means they:
(Bare aabi zakhire (jheelein, samandar) thermally stable kehlate hain. Is ka matlab hai ke woh:)

options.text: garmi mein aasani se ubal jaate hain
sardi mein jaldi jam jaate hain
un mein koi ghule namak nahi hote
temperature ki tez tabdeeli ka muqabla karte hain

blocks.explanation: Thermally stable aabi zakhire temperature ki tez tabdeeli ka muqabla karte hain (33.1 i).

book_ref.quote: This means that large bodies of water are thermally stable

blocks.prompt:
7 Water dissolves ionic substances such as nitrates (NO₃⁻) and phosphates (PO₄³⁻) by:
(Pani nitrates (NO₃⁻) aur phosphates (PO₄³⁻) jaise ionic substances ko kaise hal karta hai?)

options.text: ions ko metals mein reduce karke
ions ko gases mein oxidise karke
apne polar molecules se ions ko gher kar
ions ke saath covalent bonds bana kar

blocks.explanation: Polarity ki wajah se pani ions ko gher kar (surround karke) ionic substances ko hal karta hai (33.1 ii).

book_ref.quote: Polarity also makes water a good solvent for a wide range of ionic substances

blocks.prompt:
8 Many pesticides and herbicides easily enter the water cycle because water:
(Bohat se pesticides aur herbicides aasani se water cycle mein kyun daakhil ho jaate hain?)

options.text: pani ki heat of vaporisation zyada hai
pani polar organic compounds ko hal kar sakta hai
pani ka redox potential kam hai

blocks.explanation: Pani polar organic compounds ko hal kar sakta hai, is liye bohat se pesticides aur herbicides water cycle mein daakhil ho kar wahan tikte hain aur bioaccumulation (jism mein jama hona) hota hai (33.1 ii).

book_ref.quote: many pesticides and herbicides easily enter the water cycle

blocks.prompt:
9 The ability of water to act as both an acid and a base is called its:
(Pani ka acid aur base dono ki tarah kaam karne ki salahiyat kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pani ka acid aur base dono ki tarah kaam karna us ki amphoteric nature (dohri tabiyat) hai (33.1 iii).

book_ref.quote: The ability of water to act as both an acid and a base

blocks.prompt:
10 The self-ionisation constant of water, Kw, at 25°C is:
(25°C par pani ka self-ionisation constant, Kw, kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: 25°C par Kw = 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴ hai; pani ki self-ionisation pH scale ki bunyaad faraham karti hai (33.1 iii).

book_ref.quote: provides the baseline for the pH scale

blocks.prompt:
11 Acid rain is caused by the dissolution in water of:
(Acid rain pani mein kin cheezon ke hal hone se banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acid rain sulphur dioxide (SO₂) aur nitrogen oxides (NOₓ) ke pani mein hal hone se banti hai (33.1 iii).

book_ref.quote: caused by the dissolution of sulphur dioxide (SO₂) and nitrogen oxides (NOₓ)

blocks.prompt:
12 Pollution in the form of acid rain increases the concentration of which ion in a water body?
(Acid rain ki shakal mein pollution aabi zakhire mein kis ion ki concentration barhati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acid rain hydronium ions (H₃O⁺) ki concentration barhati hai (33.1 iii).

book_ref.quote: increases the concentration of hydronium ions (H₃O⁺)

blocks.prompt:
13 Increased acidity in a lake can mobilise which toxic compounds from sediments into the water column?
(Jheel mein barhi hui acidity sediments (tah ki mitti) se kaun se zehreele compounds pani mein le aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acidity aluminium hydroxide aur lead salts jaise zehreele heavy metal compounds ko sediments se pani ke column mein le aati hai (33.1 iii).

book_ref.quote: This acidity can mobilise toxic heavy metal compounds

blocks.prompt:
14 Dissolved oxygen (DO) refers to:
(Dissolved oxygen (DO) se kya muraad hai?)

options.text: pani ke tamam chemicals ko oxidise karne ke liye darkaar oxygen
microbes ki paanch din mein istemal ki gayi oxygen
khud pani ke molecule mein maujood oxygen
pani mein aabi jaandaron ke saans lene ke liye dastiyab oxygen

blocks.explanation: DO pani mein maujood woh oxygen hai jo aabi jaandaron (aquatic organisms) ke saans lene ke liye dastiyab ho (33.1 iv).

book_ref.quote: It refers to the amount of oxygen available in water for aquatic organisms to breathe.

blocks.prompt:
15 A low DO level in a river may suggest:
(Darya mein kam DO level kis baat ki taraf ishara kar sakta hai?)

options.text: pollution ya organic maadde ki zyada decomposition

blocks.explanation: Zyada DO aam tor par saaf pani dikhata hai; kam DO pollution ya organic maadde ki zyada decomposition (galne) ki nishani ho sakta hai (33.1 iv).

book_ref.quote: High DO levels generally indicate clean, unpolluted water

blocks.prompt:
16 Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD) is usually measured over a period of:
(Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD) aam tor par kitne arse mein naapi jaati hai?)
blocks.explanation: BOD woh oxygen hai jo microorganisms ko organic maadda torne ke liye aik muqarrara arse, aam tor par 20°C par paanch din, mein chahiye (33.1 iv).

book_ref.quote: usually five days at 20°C

blocks.prompt:
17 BOD is a key indicator of the level of which kind of pollution in water?
(BOD pani mein kis qisam ki pollution ke level ka aham ishara hai?)
blocks.explanation: BOD pani mein organic pollution ke level ka aham ishara (indicator) hai (33.1 iv).

book_ref.quote: It is a key indicator of the level of organic pollution in water.

blocks.prompt:
18 Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) is measured by oxidising substances in water with oxidising agents such as:
(Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) pani ke substances ko kin oxidising agents se oxidise karke naapi jaati hai?)
blocks.explanation: COD woh oxygen hai jo oxidising agents (KMnO₄, K₂Cr₂O₇ waghera) se organic aur inorganic substances ko chemically oxidise karne mein lagti hai (33.1 iv).

book_ref.quote: using oxidising agents (KMnO₄, K₂Cr₂O₇, etc.)

blocks.prompt:
19 Which parameter is useful for assessing the total pollution load in water, since it covers both organic and inorganic oxidisable substances?
(Kaun sa parameter pani mein kul pollution load jaanchne ke liye mufeed hai, kyun ke yeh organic aur inorganic dono oxidise hone wale substances ko shamil karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: COD organic aur inorganic dono substances ko oxidise karne wali oxygen naapti hai; yeh kul pollution load jaanchne ke liye mufeed hai (33.1 iv).

book_ref.quote: COD is useful for assessing the total pollution load in water.

blocks.prompt:
20 According to Table 33.1, a water sample with DO 4-6 mg/L, BOD 2-8 mg/L and COD 10-20 mg/L is typical of:
(Table 33.1 ke mutabiq DO 4-6 mg/L, BOD 2-8 mg/L aur COD 10-20 mg/L wala pani kis qisam ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 33.1: darmiyana aaluda (moderately polluted) pani ka DO 4-6, BOD 2-8 aur COD 10-20 mg/L hota hai (33.1 iv).

book_ref.quote: The following table outlines the typical ranges for these parameters

blocks.prompt:
21 According to Table 33.1, drinking water typically has:
(Table 33.1 ke mutabiq peene ke pani mein aam tor par:)

options.text: DO < 1 mg/L, BOD 100-400 mg/L and COD 200-1000 mg/L
DO 2-4 mg/L, BOD 10-30 mg/L and COD 30-100 mg/L
DO 0-2 mg/L, BOD 500-5000+ mg/L and COD 1000-20,000+ mg/L
DO > 6 mg/L, BOD < 2 mg/L and COD < 5 mg/L

blocks.explanation: Table 33.1: peene ke pani ka DO > 6, BOD < 2 aur COD < 5 mg/L hota hai; baqi options raw sewage, treated sewage aur industrial waste ke hain (33.1 iv).

book_ref.quote: Table 33.1 Typical ranges of DO, BOD, and COD in water

blocks.prompt:
22 From Table 33.1, which type of water has the lowest dissolved oxygen together with BOD of 100-400 mg/L?
(Table 33.1 se, kis qisam ke pani mein sab se kam dissolved oxygen aur BOD 100-400 mg/L hai?)
blocks.explanation: Raw sewage: DO < 1 mg/L, BOD 100-400 mg/L, COD 200-1000 mg/L (Table 33.1).

book_ref.quote: suggesting heavy pollution, which can deplete dissolved oxygen

blocks.prompt:
23 The redox potential of water is a measure of its:
(Pani ka redox potential kis cheez ka paimana hai?)
blocks.explanation: Redox potential aabi zakhire ki oxidising aur reducing tabiyat ka paimana hai (33.1 v).

book_ref.quote: The redox potential of water is a measure of the oxidising and reducing nature of a water body.

blocks.prompt:
24 In well-oxygenated water, sulphur and carbon are present mainly as:
(Achhi oxygen wale pani mein sulphur aur carbon zyada tar kis shakal mein hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Achhi oxygen wale pani mein species apni sab se oxidised shakal, jaise SO₄²⁻ aur CO₂, mein hoti hain (33.1 v).

book_ref.quote: In well-oxygenated water, chemical species exist in their most oxidised forms

blocks.prompt:
25 In polluted or stagnant water where oxygen is depleted, the environment becomes reducing and forms toxic:
(Aaluda ya khade pani mein, jahan oxygen khatam ho jaye, mahol reducing ban jaata hai aur kaun se zehreele substances bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Oxygen ki kami se mahol reducing ho jaata hai aur zehreele hydrogen sulphide (H₂S) aur ammonia (NH₃) bante hain (33.1 v).

book_ref.quote: This leads to the formation of toxic substances like hydrogen sulphide (H₂S) and ammonia (NH₃).

blocks.prompt:
26 Contamination that enters a water body from a single, discrete and identifiable location is called:
(Woh aaloodgi jo aabi zakhire mein aik akeli, alag aur pehchani ja sakne wali jagah se daakhil ho, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Point-source pollution aik akeli, alag aur pehchani ja sakne wali jagah ya point se daakhil hoti hai (33.2).

book_ref.quote: from a single, discrete, and identifiable location or point

blocks.prompt:
27 Which is an example of point-source pollution?
(Point-source pollution ki misaal kaun si hai?)

options.text: barish ka bohat se kheton se fertilizer darya mein bahana
roads aur car parks par behta stormwater
barf pighalne ka pani jo wasee wadi par mitti bahata hai
factory ka pipe jo darya mein mercury salts daalta hai

blocks.explanation: Factory ka khaas wastewater pipe se lead ya mercury salts darya mein daalna point source hai; baqi non-point hain (33.2).

book_ref.quote: An example is a factory discharging lead or mercury salts directly into a river

blocks.prompt:
28 At the site of a point-source discharge, the high concentration of pollutant leads to:
(Point-source discharge ki jagah par pollutant ki zyada concentration kis cheez ka baais banti hai?)

options.text: wasee ilaqe mein yaksaan kam pollution

blocks.explanation: Point source ke foran neeche pollutant ki concentration sab se zyada hoti hai, jis se maqami shadeed zehreelapan (localized acute toxicity) hota hai (33.2).

book_ref.quote: concentrations of the pollutant (such as heavy metals or organic waste) are at their highest

blocks.prompt:
29 Non-point source pollution is also known as:
(Non-point source pollution ko aur kis naam se jaana jaata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Non-point source pollution ko diffused (phaili hui) pollution bhi kehte hain (33.2).

book_ref.quote: Non-point source pollution, also known as diffused pollution

blocks.prompt:
30 Non-point source pollution occurs when:
(Non-point source pollution kab hoti hai?)

options.text: aik akela pipe waste daalta hai
barish ya pighalti barf ka pani zameen ke oopar aur andar se guzarta hai
storage tank aik jagah se leak hota hai
jahaz aik jagah tel giraata hai

blocks.explanation: NPS pollution tab hoti hai jab barish ya pighalti barf ka pani zameen ke oopar aur andar se guzar kar pollutants utha leta hai (33.2).

book_ref.quote: occurs when rainfall or snowmelt moves over and through the ground

blocks.prompt:
31 Compared with point-source pollution, NPS pollution results in:
(Point-source ke muqable mein NPS pollution ka nateeja kya hota hai?)

options.text: wasee ilaqe par kam concentration mein pollutants ka mixture
aik jagah par aik pollutant bohat zyada concentration mein

blocks.explanation: NPS pollution se mukhtalif pollutants ka mixture kam concentration mein bohat wasee ilaqe par phailta hai (33.2).

book_ref.quote: It results in a mixture of various pollutants at lower concentrations across a much wider area.

blocks.prompt:
32 Stormwater moving over roads and car parks collects:
(Roads aur car parks par behne wala stormwater kya jama karta hai?)

options.text: engine oil, tyres ka zinc aur road salts

blocks.explanation: Pakki satah (roads, car parks) par behta stormwater leak shuda engine oil (hydrocarbons), tyres ka zinc aur road salts jama karta hai (33.2).

book_ref.quote: zinc from tires, and road salts

blocks.prompt:
33 Into how many types are the sources of water pollution divided in this chapter?
(Is chapter mein water pollution ke sources ko kitni qismon mein taqseem kiya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sources ya to aik point hain ya bohat si jaghein, is liye do qismein hain: point aur non-point (33.2).

book_ref.quote: Based on this, the sources of water pollution are divided into two types.

blocks.prompt:
34 Contamination of water by harmful bacteria, viruses, protozoa and parasites is called:
(Nuqsan deh bacteria, viruses, protozoa aur parasites se pani ki aaloodgi kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Microbiological pollution nuqsan deh khurdbeeni jaandaron (microorganisms) se pani ki aaloodgi hai (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Microbiological pollution is the contamination of water by harmful microorganisms

blocks.prompt:
35 Which of the following is a common pathogen found in microbiologically polluted water?
(Microbiologically aaluda pani mein paya jaane wala aam pathogen (bimari phailane wala jaandar) kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aam pathogens mein Escherichia coli, Salmonella aur Giardia shamil hain (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Common pathogens found in microbiologically polluted water include

blocks.prompt:
36 Which of the following is a water-borne disease caused by microorganisms?
(In mein se kaun si bimari microorganisms se phailne wali water-borne (pani se lagne wali) bimari hai?)
blocks.explanation: Water-borne bimariyon mein cholera, typhoid, dysentery aur hepatitis A shamil hain; baqi heavy metals se hoti hain (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Common water-borne diseases include cholera, typhoid, dysentery, and hepatitis A.

blocks.prompt:
37 Microbiological pollution typically results from the discharge of:
(Microbiological pollution aam tor par kis ke kharij hone se hoti hai?)

options.text: bina saaf kiya sewage, haiwanon ka fuzla aur hospital waste

blocks.explanation: Yeh bina saaf kiye sewage, haiwanon ke fuzla, hospital waste aur kheton ke bahao se hoti hai (33.3).

book_ref.quote: animal waste, hospital waste, and runoff from agricultural lands into water bodies

blocks.prompt:
38 Heavy metals enter water systems mainly through:
(Heavy metals pani ke nizam mein zyada tar kaise daakhil hoti hain?)

options.text: industrial discharge, mining aur waste ko ghalat tareeqe se phenkna

blocks.explanation: Heavy metals industrial discharge, kaan-kani (mining) aur waste ko ghalat tareeqe se phenkne se pani mein aati hain (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Heavy metals can enter water systems through industrial discharge, mining operations

blocks.prompt:
39 Mercury enters water primarily from:
(Mercury zyada tar kahan se pani mein aata hai?)

options.text: koyla jalana, sone ki mining aur thermometer ya battery industry

blocks.explanation: Mercury zyada tar koyla jalane, sone ki kaan-kani aur thermometer ya battery banane ki industry ke waste se aata hai (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Mercury can enter water primarily from coal combustion, gold mining

blocks.prompt:
40 In aquatic sediments, inorganic mercury is converted into methylmercury by:
(Aabi sediments mein inorganic mercury ko methylmercury mein kaun badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aabi sediments mein bacteria inorganic mercury ko methylmercury ([CH₃Hg]⁺) mein badalte hain (33.3).

book_ref.quote: bacteria convert inorganic mercury into methylmercury

blocks.prompt:
41 Lead ions (Pb²⁺) often enter water systems through:
(Lead ions (Pb²⁺) aksar pani ke nizam mein kaise daakhil hote hain?)

options.text: purane lead pipes ka corrosion (zang lagna)

blocks.explanation: Lead ions aksar pipes ke zang lagne (corrosion) se pani mein aate hain; purani plumbing (lead pipes) bara source hai (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Lead ions (Pb²⁺) often enter water systems through the corrosion of pipes.

blocks.prompt:
42 Phosphate fertilizer impurities, metal plating and plastic stabilisers are major sources of:
(Phosphate fertilizer ki milawat, metal plating aur plastic stabilisers kis ke bare sources hain?)
blocks.explanation: Metal plating, plastic stabilisers aur phosphate fertilizer ki milawat cadmium ke bare sources hain (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Metal plating, plastic stabilisers, and phosphate fertilizer impurities are major sources of cadmium

blocks.prompt:
43 Heavy metals tend to accumulate in the tissues of living organisms because they are:
(Heavy metals jaandaron ke tissues mein kyun jama hoti rehti hain?)

options.text: non-biodegradable (qudrati tor par na galne wali)
aasani se CO₂ mein oxidise hone wali
bacteria se jaldi toot jaane wali

blocks.explanation: Heavy metals ke atomic weights aur densities zyada hain; non-biodegradable (qudrati tor par na galne wali) hone ki wajah se tissues mein jama hoti hain (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Heavy metals have high atomic weights and densities.

blocks.prompt:
44 Methylmercury easily crosses biological membranes and undergoes biomagnification because it is:
(Methylmercury aasani se biological membranes paar karke biomagnification kyun karta hai?)

options.text: sirf pani mein bohat hal hone wala
charbi mein bohat hal hone wala (fat-soluble)

blocks.explanation: Methylmercury charbi mein bohat hal hone wala (fat-soluble) hai, is liye membranes paar karke biomagnification karta hai (33.3).

book_ref.quote: is highly fat-soluble, allowing it to easily cross biological membranes

blocks.prompt:
45 Long-term exposure to methylmercury leads to Minamata disease, which is characterised by:
(Methylmercury ke lambe arse tak asar se Minamata bimari hoti hai, jis ki nishaniyan kya hain?)

options.text: kamzor (bhurbhuri) haddiyan aur gurde ka nuqsan
khoon ki kami aur nashonuma mein der
ataxia (tawazun ki kharabi), haath paon sun hona aur pathon ki kamzori

blocks.explanation: Minamata bimari mein ataxia (jism ke tawazun ki kharabi), haath paon sun hona aur pathon ki kamzori hoti hai (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Long term exposure leads to Minamata disease

blocks.prompt:
46 Methylmercury is described as a potent neurotoxin because it:
(Methylmercury ko taqatwar neurotoxin (aasaab ka zehar) kyun kaha gaya hai?)

options.text: haddiyon mein calcium ki jagah le leta hai
blood-brain barrier paar kar leta hai
pani mein dhoop rok deta hai
nitrates ko ammonia mein reduce karta hai

blocks.explanation: Methylmercury taqatwar neurotoxin hai jo blood-brain barrier (khoon aur dimagh ke darmiyan rukawat) paar kar leta hai (33.3).

book_ref.quote: It is a potent neurotoxin that crosses the blood-brain barrier.

blocks.prompt:
47 Lead causes anaemia because it:
(Lead anaemia (khoon ki kami) kyun paida karta hai?)

options.text: haemoglobin ki tayyari mein rukawat daalta hai
haddiyon mein calcium ki jagah le leta hai
nitrates ko nitrites mein badalta hai
dimagh ki charbi ghol deta hai

blocks.explanation: Lead haemoglobin ki tayyari mein rukawat daalta hai, jis se anaemia hota hai (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Lead interferes with the production of haemoglobin, leading to anaemia.

blocks.prompt:
48 In children, lead acts as a cumulative poison causing:
(Bachon mein lead jama hone wale zehar ki tarah kya nuqsan karta hai?)

options.text: na theek hone wala aasaabi (neurological) nuqsan aur nashonuma mein der

blocks.explanation: Bachon mein lead jama hone wala zehar hai jo na theek hone wala aasaabi nuqsan aur nashonuma mein der paida karta hai (33.3).

book_ref.quote: it acts as a cumulative poison that causes irreversible neurological damage

blocks.prompt:
49 Besides affecting the bones, long-term ingestion of cadmium also causes:
(Haddiyon ke ilawa cadmium ke lambe arse tak khaane se aur kya nuqsan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cadmium Itai-itai bimari ke ilawa gurdon ka shadeed nuqsan (nephrotoxicity) bhi karta hai (33.3).

book_ref.quote: It also causes severe kidney damage (nephrotoxicity).

blocks.prompt:
50 Cd²⁺ ions can replace Ca²⁺ ions in bones because Cd²⁺ ions have:
(Cd²⁺ ions haddiyon mein Ca²⁺ ions ki jagah kyun le sakte hain?)

options.text: bohat bara size aur kam charge

blocks.explanation: Figure ke mutabiq Cd²⁺ ions ki charge density zyada hai, is liye woh haddiyon mein Ca²⁺ ki jagah le lete hain (33.3).

book_ref.quote: ions have higher charge density so they can replace Ca2+ ions in bones

blocks.prompt:
51 According to Table 33.2, which heavy metal has the lowest WHO permissible limit in drinking water?
(Table 33.2 ke mutabiq peene ke pani mein kis heavy metal ki WHO hadd sab se kam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 33.2: Cd 0.003 mg/L sab se kam hai; Hg 0.006, As aur Pb 0.01, Cr 0.05, Cu 2.0 mg/L (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Table 33.2 WHO permissible limits of heavy metals in drinking water

blocks.prompt:
52 A well-water sample contains 0.03 mg/L of lead. Using the WHO limit in Table 33.2, the lead level is:
(Kunwein ke pani mein lead 0.03 mg/L hai. Table 33.2 ki WHO hadd se yeh level:)

options.text: ijazat shuda hadd ka aik tihai

blocks.explanation: Pb ki WHO hadd = 0.01 mg/L; 0.03 / 0.01 = 3, yani sample hadd se 3 guna hai (Table 33.2).

book_ref.quote: The limiting concentrations (mg/L) of some heavy metals are provided in Table 33.2.

blocks.prompt:
53 The Minamata Disaster of the 1950s in Japan was caused by the release of:
(1950s mein Japan ka Minamata haadsa kis cheez ke kharij hone se hua?)
blocks.explanation: Minamata haadsa pani mein methylmercury chhorne se hua, jis se mercury ka zehar phail gaya (Did You Know?, 33.3).

book_ref.quote: The Minamata Disaster was a severe case of industrial pollution that occurred in the 1950s

blocks.prompt:
54 The major sources of pesticides and herbicides in water are:
(Pani mein pesticides aur herbicides ke bare sources kaun se hain?)

options.text: kheton ka bahao aur gharelu bagbani
koyla jalana aur sone ki mining

blocks.explanation: Pesticides aur herbicides ke bare sources kheton ka bahao (agricultural runoff) aur gharelu bagbani hain (33.3).

book_ref.quote: The major sources of these are agricultural runoff and domestic gardening.

blocks.prompt:
55 Older pesticides such as DDT are classed as:
(DDT jaise purane pesticides kis zumre mein aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: DDT jaise bohat se purane pesticides persistent organic pollutants (POPs, der tak tikne wale organic aaloodgi) hain (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Many older pesticides like DDT are persistent organic pollutants (POPs).

blocks.prompt:
56 DDT is non-polar and insoluble in water, but it is highly soluble in:
(DDT non-polar aur pani mein na hal hone wala hai, lekin yeh kis mein bohat hal hota hai?)

options.text: machhliyon aur parindon ke charbi wale tissues

blocks.explanation: DDT non-polar aur pani mein na hal hone wala hai magar machhliyon aur parindon ke charbi wale tissues mein bohat hal hota hai (33.3; Book correction ke mutabiq yeh DDT par sach hai, glyphosate polar aur pani mein hal hone wala hai).

book_ref.quote: but highly soluble in the fatty tissues of fish and birds

blocks.prompt:
57 Many pesticides act as endocrine disruptors. In wildlife this can lead to:
(Bohat se pesticides endocrine disruptors (hormones mein khalal daalne wale) hain. Jangli haiwanon mein is ka nateeja kya ho sakta hai?)

options.text: nasal-kashi ki nakami, jaise parindon ke andon ke chhilke patle hona

blocks.explanation: Endocrine disruptor pesticides jangli haiwanon mein nasal-kashi ki nakami, maslan parindon ke andon ke chhilke patle hona, paida karte hain (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Many pesticides act as endocrine disruptors like natural hormones

blocks.prompt:
58 Polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) have been used in electrical transformers as:
(Polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) electrical transformers mein kis tor par istemal hue?)
blocks.explanation: PCBs (polychlorinated biphenyls; kitab mein ghalti se 'biphenols' chhapa hai) transformers mein coolants (thanda karne wale) ke tor par istemal hue (33.3).

book_ref.quote: have been used in electrical transformers as coolants

blocks.prompt:
59 PCBs are classified as probable human carcinogens. They also:
(PCBs ko mumkina insani carcinogens (cancer paida karne wale) mana jaata hai. Yeh aur kya karte hain?)

options.text: immune system ko dabate aur chloracne paida karte hain
pani se lagne wali bimariyon ka ilaaj karte hain
daryaon mein dissolved oxygen barhate hain

blocks.explanation: PCBs mumkina carcinogens hain; yeh immune system (mudafati nizam) ko dabate hain aur chloracne jaisi jild ki bimariyan karte hain (33.3).

book_ref.quote: They also suppress the immune system and cause skin conditions

blocks.prompt:
60 Eutrophication (nutrient pollution) is caused mainly by excess of which nutrients?
(Eutrophication (ghizaai ajza ki aaloodgi) zyada tar kin nutrients ki zyadti se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Eutrophication tab hoti hai jab zyada nutrients, khaas kar nitrogen aur phosphorus, aabi zakhiron mein aa jaate hain (33.3).

book_ref.quote: primarily nitrogen and phosphorus, enter into water bodies

blocks.prompt:
61 The rapid growth of algae caused by excess nutrients in water is called:
(Pani mein zyada nutrients se algae ki tez barhotri ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada nutrients se algae tezi se barhti hai jise algal bloom kehte hain (33.3).

book_ref.quote: leads to the rapid growth of algae, commonly referred to as algal blooms

blocks.prompt:
62 When algal blooms die and decompose they consume large amounts of oxygen, creating:
(Jab algal blooms mar kar galte hain to bohat si oxygen kha jaate hain aur kya bante hain?)

options.text: hypoxic dead zones jahan aabi zindagi nahi bach sakti
zyada redox potential aur saaf pani ke ilaqe

blocks.explanation: Galte hue blooms bohat si oxygen kha jaate hain aur hypoxic (kam oxygen wale) 'dead zones' bante hain jahan aabi zindagi nahi bach sakti (33.3).

book_ref.quote: When they die and decompose, they consume large amounts of oxygen

blocks.prompt:
63 High nitrate levels in drinking water are dangerous for infants because they cause:
(Peene ke pani mein zyada nitrate bachon (infants) ke liye khatarnak kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada nitrate se Blue Baby Syndrome (methaemoglobinaemia) hota hai jis mein khoon ki oxygen le jaane ki salahiyat kam ho jaati hai (33.3).

book_ref.quote: High nitrate levels in drinking water are particularly dangerous for infants.

blocks.prompt:
64 Spilled oil spreading over the sea surface harms marine life mainly by forming a layer that:
(Samandar ki satah par phaila tel aik teh bana kar samandari zindagi ko kaise nuqsan deta hai?)

options.text: dhoop rokti aur oxygen ka tabadla kam karti hai
samandari pani ko naram karti hai
pani se heavy metals nikal deti hai

blocks.explanation: Gira hua tel pani ki satah par teh banata hai jo dhoop rokti aur oxygen ke tabadle ko kam karti hai (33.3).

book_ref.quote: it spreads rapidly across the water surface, forming a layer

blocks.prompt:
65 Marine mammals commonly ingest toxic oil from a spill while:
(Samandari mammals (doodh pilane wale jaandar) tel ke phailao se zehreela tel aam tor par kab nigal lete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Samandari mammals apni safai (grooming) karte hue zehreela tel nigal lete hain (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Marine mammals can ingest the toxic oil while grooming

blocks.prompt:
66 Unlike organic materials, plastics in water:
(Organic cheezon ke baraks, pani mein plastics:)

options.text: chand dinon mein biodegrade ho jaate hain
samandari pani mein poori tarah ghul jaate hain
bacteria jaldi CO₂ mein oxidise kar dete hain
biodegrade nahi hote balke chhote zarron mein toot kar sadiyon tak rehte hain

blocks.explanation: Plastics biodegrade nahi hote; chhote zarron mein toot kar sadiyon tak mahol mein rehte hain (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Unlike organic materials, plastics do not biodegrade

blocks.prompt:
67 Turtles, dolphins and birds are often injured or killed at sea by:
(Samandar mein kachhuye, dolphins aur parinde aksar kis wajah se zakhmi ya halaak hote hain?)

options.text: purane jaal aur malbe mein phansna

blocks.explanation: Purane machhli pakarne ke jaal aur malbe mein phansna kachhuon, dolphins aur parindon ko zakhmi ya halaak karta hai (33.3).

book_ref.quote: Sometimes entanglement in old fishing gear and other debris

blocks.prompt:
68 Microplastics raise concerns about human health because they have:
(Microplastics insani sehat ke liye fikr ki wajah kyun hain?)

options.text: barish ka pH barha diya hai
food chain mein daakhil ho chuke hain
pani ki specific heat barha di hai
haddiyon mein calcium ki jagah le li hai

blocks.explanation: Microplastics food chain (ghizaai silsile) mein daakhil ho chuke hain, is liye insani sehat par asar ki fikr hai (33.3).

book_ref.quote: microplastics have entered the food chain

blocks.text: 33.4 Water Pollution due to Human Activities

blocks.prompt:
69 Contaminants often reach rivers, lakes and oceans because of:
(Aaloodgi aksar daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron tak kis wajah se pohanchti hai?)

options.text: waste ka ghalat intezam aur mahooliyati qawaneen ki kami

blocks.explanation: Waste ka ghalat intezam aur mahooliyati qawaneen ki kami aksar aaloodgi ko aabi zakhiron tak le jaati hai (33.4).

book_ref.quote: Improper waste management and lack of environmental regulations

blocks.prompt:
70 Which of the following industries is listed as a common source of water pollution?
(In mein se kaun si industry water pollution ka aam source bataayi gayi hai?)

options.text: barish ka pani jama karne ke units

blocks.explanation: Aam aaluda karne wali industries: oil refineries, chemical plants, automobile industry, fertilizers aur tanneries (chamra rangne ke karkhane) (33.4).

book_ref.quote: Industrial activities are the major source of water pollution.

blocks.prompt:
71 Poor irrigation practices pollute rivers and streams mainly by:
(Ghalat aabpashi (irrigation) ke tareeqe daryaon aur nadiyon ko zyada tar kaise aaluda karte hain?)

options.text: mitti ka kataao barha kar sediments un mein bahana

blocks.explanation: Ghalat aabpashi mitti ke kataao (soil erosion) ko barhati hai aur sediments daryaon mein beh jaate hain (33.4).

book_ref.quote: Poor irrigation practices can increase soil erosion

blocks.prompt:
72 Which of the following is household waste that often enters drains and reaches water bodies?
(In mein se kaun sa gharelu waste aksar naaliyon se aabi zakhiron tak pohanchta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Detergents, tel aur chemicals jaisa gharelu waste naaliyon se aakhir aabi zakhiron tak pohanchta hai (33.4).

book_ref.quote: Household waste such as detergents, oils, and chemicals often enter drains

blocks.prompt:
73 Plastics dumped in or near water channels lead to:
(Pani ki naliyon ke andar ya qareeb phenke gaye plastics ka nateeja kya hai?)

options.text: rukawat aur lambe arse ki aaloodgi

blocks.explanation: Naliyon mein ya un ke qareeb phenka gaya plastic rukawat aur lambe arse ki aaloodgi ka baais banta hai (33.4).

book_ref.quote: plastics are frequently dumped in or near water channels

blocks.prompt:
74 When trees and vegetation are removed, water pollution increases because:
(Darakht aur sabza hatane se water pollution kyun barhti hai?)

options.text: pani thermally stable ho jaata hai
dheeli mitti kat kar daryaon mein sediment daalti hai
heavy metals nutrients mein badal jaate hain

blocks.explanation: Sabza hatane se mitti dheeli ho kar kat jaati hai aur daryaon mein sediment barh jaata hai (33.4).

book_ref.quote: the soil becomes loose and more prone to erosion

blocks.prompt:
75 Recreational boating pollutes water mainly by releasing:
(Tafreehi kashti rani (boating) pani ko zyada tar kis cheez se aaluda karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kashtiyan aksar tel, fuel aur doosre chemicals pani mein chhorti hain jo aabi zindagi ko nuqsan dete hain (33.4).

book_ref.quote: Boats often release oil, fuel, and other chemicals into the water

blocks.prompt:
76 Besides oil spills, which routine activity of marine transport can release toxic substances into water?
(Tel ke phailao ke ilawa samandari transport ki kaun si maamool ki sargarmi pani mein zehreele maadde chhor sakti hai?)

options.text: jahaz ke hull ki safai aur rang

blocks.explanation: Jahaz ke dhaanche (hull) ki safai aur rang jaisi maamool ki dekh bhaal zehreele maadde pani mein chhor sakti hai (33.4).

book_ref.quote: Routine maintenance, such as hull cleaning and painting

blocks.text: 33.5 Effect of Water Pollution on the Environment

blocks.prompt:
77 Which of the following is a common environmental impact of water pollution?
(Water pollution ka aam mahooliyati asar kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aam asraat: biodiversity (hayati tanawwo) ka nuqsan, maskan ki tabahi, food chains mein khalal aur pani ke miyaar mein kami (33.5).

book_ref.quote: Common environmental impacts include loss of biodiversity

blocks.prompt:
78 Polluted water makes it difficult for aquatic life to survive because it reduces oxygen levels, causing:
(Aaluda pani oxygen kam karke aabi zindagi ko mushkil bana deta hai; is halat ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aaluda pani oxygen ka level kam karta hai jis se hypoxia (oxygen ki kami) hoti hai (33.5).

book_ref.quote: Polluted water reduces oxygen levels, causing hypoxia

blocks.prompt:
79 By disrupting breeding cycles, food sources and migration patterns, polluted water can lead to:
(Nasal-kashi, khuraak ke zaraye aur hijrat ke nizam mein khalal daal kar aaluda pani kis cheez ka baais ban sakta hai?)

options.text: aabadi mein kami aur hassas species ka khatma

blocks.explanation: Is khalal se aabadi mein kami aur hassas species ki naslen khatam (extinction) ho sakti hain (33.5).

book_ref.quote: Polluted water disrupts breeding cycles, food sources, and migration patterns

blocks.prompt:
80 Nutrient overload from fertilizers and sewage harms ecosystems because the rapid growth of algae:
(Fertilizers aur sewage se nutrients ki zyadti mahooliyati nizam ko kyun nuqsan deti hai?)

options.text: nitrogen aur phosphorus ko hamesha ke liye nikal deti hai
dhoop rokti aur oxygen kam karti hai
pani ko high-purity pani bana deti hai

blocks.explanation: Zyada nitrogen aur phosphorus se algae tezi se barhti hai jo dhoop rokti aur oxygen kam karti hai (33.5).

book_ref.quote: leads to a rapid growth of algae, which block sunlight and reduce oxygen levels in the water

blocks.prompt:
81 The increase in concentration of a toxin such as mercury as it moves up the food chain is called:
(Food chain mein oopar jaate hue mercury jaise zehar ki concentration ka barhna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zehar food chain mein oopar jaate hue zyada concentrated hote jaate hain; ise biomagnification kehte hain (33.5).

book_ref.quote: become more concentrated as they move up the food chain

blocks.prompt:
82 Because of biomagnification, the highest doses of toxins are often received by:
(Biomagnification ki wajah se zehar ki sab se zyada miqdaar aksar kis ko milti hai?)

options.text: sab se oopar ke shikari (top predators), insaan bhi

blocks.explanation: Food chain ke oopar wale shikari, insaanon samet, aksar sab se zyada miqdaar paate hain (33.5).

book_ref.quote: Top predators, including humans, often receive the highest doses.

blocks.prompt:
83 Polluted water damages soil fertility because accumulated chemicals:
(Aaluda pani mitti ki zarkhezi ko kyun nuqsan deta hai?)

options.text: mitti ki qudrati microbial sargarmi bigaar dete hain
mitti ki microbial sargarmi barhate hain
mitti mein pani jaane ka rasta band kar dete hain
mitti ko bajri bana dete hain

blocks.explanation: Jama shuda chemicals mitti ki qudrati microbial (khurdbeeni jaandaron ki) sargarmi bigaar dete hain jo paudon ki sehat ke liye zaroori hai (33.5).

book_ref.quote: Accumulated chemicals disrupt the soil's natural microbial activity

blocks.prompt:
84 Plants exposed to polluted water may show:
(Aaluda pani lagne wale paudon mein kya nishaniyan ho sakti hain?)

options.text: tez barhotri aur zyada hare patte
ruki hui barhotri aur patton ka rang badalna

blocks.explanation: Aaluda pani wale paude ruki hui barhotri, patton ka rang badalna dikhate hain aur mar bhi sakte hain (33.5).

book_ref.quote: Plants exposed to polluted water may exhibit stunted growth

blocks.prompt:
85 When organisms die and decompose in oxygen-poor (anaerobic) water, the potent greenhouse gas released is:
(Jab jaandar oxygen ki kami wale (anaerobic) pani mein mar kar galte hain to kaun si taqatwar greenhouse gas nikalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxygen ki kami (anaerobic) mein galne se methane nikalti hai jo taqatwar greenhouse gas hai (33.5).

book_ref.quote: methane, a potent greenhouse gas, is released

blocks.prompt:
86 In wastewater treatment, secondary treatment refers to:
(Wastewater treatment mein secondary treatment se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primary treatment mein physical malba nikalta hai, secondary mein biological processing hoti hai aur tertiary mein chemical safai (33.6).

book_ref.quote: primary treatment (removal of physical debris)

blocks.prompt:
87 Tertiary treatment of wastewater is:
(Wastewater ka tertiary treatment kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tertiary treatment chemical safai (purification) hai (33.6).

book_ref.quote: and tertiary treatment (chemical purification)

blocks.prompt:
88 In the initial stage of water treatment, large insoluble particles are removed by:
(Water treatment ke pehle marhale mein bare na hal hone wale zarre kaise nikale jaate hain?)

options.text: pani ko metal screens (jaaliyon) se guzaar kar

blocks.explanation: Bare na hal hone wale zarre pani ko metal ki jaaliyon (screens) se guzaar kar nikale jaate hain (33.6 i).

book_ref.quote: Large insoluble particles are removed by passing water through metal screens.

blocks.prompt:
89 In sedimentation, suspended solids settle at the bottom of large tanks under the influence of:
(Sedimentation mein latke hue thos zarre bare tankon ki tah mein kis ke asar se baithte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sedimentation mein pani bare tankon mein rakha jaata hai taake latke zarre gravity (kashish-e-saql) se tah mein baith jayein (33.6 i).

book_ref.quote: to allow suspended solids to settle at the bottom under the influence of gravity

blocks.prompt:
90 Coagulation and flocculation are employed in water treatment to:
(Water treatment mein coagulation aur flocculation kis liye kiye jaate hain?)

options.text: bareek colloidal zarron ka baithna tez karna

blocks.explanation: Coagulation aur flocculation bareek colloidal zarron ke baithne ki raftaar barhane ke liye kiye jaate hain (33.6 ii).

book_ref.quote: To speed up the settling of finer colloidal particles

blocks.prompt:
91 The larger masses formed when small particles clump together after adding a coagulant are called:
(Coagulant daalne ke baad chhote zarron ke jur kar bane bare dhele kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Coagulants chhote zarron ko jor kar bare dhele banate hain jinhein 'floc' kehte hain aur woh aasani se nikal jaate hain (33.6 ii).

book_ref.quote: These chemicals cause the smaller particles to clump together into larger masses called

blocks.prompt:
92 In a standard treatment plant, filtration is done by passing water through:
(Aam treatment plant mein filtration ke liye pani ko kis se guzaara jaata hai?)

options.text: darja-ba-darja ret aur bajri ki tehein

blocks.explanation: Pani darja-ba-darja ret aur bajri ki tehon se guzarta hai; ret daanon ke darmiyan khali jagah mein zarre rok leti hai (33.6 iii).

book_ref.quote: In a standard treatment plant, water passes through layers of graded sand and gravel.

blocks.prompt:
93 For more advanced purification during filtration, the material used is:
(Filtration mein mazeed behtar safai ke liye kaun sa maadda istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mazeed behtar safai ke liye activated carbon istemal hota hai (33.6 iii).

book_ref.quote: For more advanced purification, activated carbon is used.

blocks.prompt:
94 The most common method of disinfection of water is:
(Pani ko jaraseem se paak karne (disinfection) ka sab se aam tareeqa kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chlorination disinfection ka sab se aam tareeqa hai (33.6 iv).

book_ref.quote: Chlorination is the most common method of disinfection.

blocks.prompt:
95 When chlorine gas or sodium hypochlorite is added to water, the species that penetrates the cell walls of bacteria and viruses is:
(Jab pani mein chlorine gas ya sodium hypochlorite daala jaye to kaun si cheez bacteria aur viruses ki cell walls mein ghus jaati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chlorine ya NaOCl se hypochlorous acid (HOCl) banta hai jo bacteria aur viruses ki cell walls mein ghus kar un ke kaam bigaarta hai (33.6 iv).

book_ref.quote: it forms hypochlorous acid (HOCl)

blocks.prompt:
96 Chemical purification is necessary after filtration because filtration alone cannot remove:
(Filtration ke baad chemical safai kyun zaroori hai?)

options.text: ghule hue ions ya khurdbeeni pathogens

blocks.explanation: Sirf filtration ghule hue ions ya khurdbeeni pathogens nahi nikal sakti; is liye chemical safai zaroori hai (33.6 iv).

book_ref.quote: Filtration alone cannot remove dissolved ions or microscopic pathogens

blocks.prompt:
97 Apart from chlorine and sodium hypochlorite, which agent is mentioned for disinfection of water?
(Chlorine aur sodium hypochlorite ke ilawa disinfection ke liye kis cheez ka zikr hai?)
blocks.explanation: Doosre tareeqon mein NaOCl aur ozone (O₃), kabhi hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) ke saath, shamil hain (33.6 iv).

book_ref.quote: ozone (O₃) or sometimes with hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂)

blocks.prompt:
98 The reverse osmosis (RO) method removes dissolved salts and bacteria by using:
(Reverse osmosis (RO) ghule namak aur bacteria kis cheez se nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: RO pressure ke tehat semi-permeable membrane (neem guzargah jhilli) istemal karta hai jo ghule namak, bacteria waghera rok leti hai (33.6 v).

book_ref.quote: The RO method uses a semi-permeable membrane

blocks.prompt:
99 Hard water causes problems in industry and with soap because it contains high concentrations of:
(Sakht pani (hard water) industry aur saabun mein masla kyun karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hard water mein Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ ions zyada hote hain jo industrial processes aur saabun ki karkardagi mein rukawat daalte hain (33.6 v).

book_ref.quote: Hard water contains high concentrations of Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ ions

blocks.prompt:
100 RO and ion exchange methods are used for:
(RO aur ion exchange tareeqe kis kaam ke liye istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: RO aur ion exchange high-purity (bohat khalis) pani banane ke liye, jaise laboratory ya zyada namkeen ilaqon ke liye, istemal hote hain (33.6 v).

book_ref.quote: For the production of high-purity water, such as that required in laboratory settings

blocks.text: 33.7 Protection and Conservation of Water Resources

blocks.prompt:
101 Which of the following is a pollution-control strategy given in the chapter?
(Chapter mein di gayi pollution control ki strategy kaun si hai?)

options.text: tamam sewage treatment plants khatam karna
pani ke miyaar ki nigrani band karna

blocks.explanation: Pollution control mein sewage treatment plants behtar karna, Effluent Treatment Plants (ETPs) lagana aur jadeed technologies shamil hain (33.7.1).

book_ref.quote: installing Effluent Treatment Plants (ETPs)

blocks.prompt:
102 Modern technologies mentioned for upgrading sewage treatment include:
(Sewage treatment ko behtar banane ke liye kin jadeed technologies ka zikr hai?)
blocks.explanation: Behtar plants mein membrane filtration aur bioreactors jaisi jadeed technologies apnai jaati hain (33.7.1).

book_ref.quote: such as membrane filtration and bioreactors

blocks.prompt:
103 Continuous water quality monitoring helps pollution control mainly by:
(Pani ke miyaar ki musalsal nigrani pollution control mein zyada tar kaise madad karti hai?)

options.text: pollutants ka pata chala kar bar waqt kaarwai karna

blocks.explanation: Musalsal nigrani se pollutants ka pata chalta hai aur aaloodgi par bar waqt kaarwai hoti hai (33.7.1).

book_ref.quote: By continuous water quality monitoring, which enables the detection of pollutants

blocks.prompt:
104 Which water-saving technologies in agriculture reduce water wastage while improving crop yield?
(Zaraat mein pani bachane wali kaun si technologies pani ka zayaa kam karke paidawar barhati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Drip aur sprinkler irrigation pani ka zayaa kafi kam karti aur paidawar behtar karti hain (33.7.2).

book_ref.quote: drip irrigation and sprinkler irrigation in agriculture

blocks.prompt:
105 Greywater from laundry, dishwashing and bathing can be reused for:
(Kapre, bartan aur nahane ka istemal shuda pani (greywater) kis kaam mein dobara laaya ja sakta hai?)

options.text: bagbani, toilet flush aur industrial cooling

blocks.explanation: Greywater ko bagbani, toilet flush aur industrial cooling mein dobara istemal karke meetha pani bachaya ja sakta hai (33.7.2).

book_ref.quote: Reusing and recycling greywater, such as household laundry

blocks.prompt:
106 Constructing small dams and recharge wells helps to:
(Chhote dams aur recharge wells banana kis cheez mein madad karta hai?)

options.text: barish ka pani jama karna aur zer-e-zameen pani bharna

blocks.explanation: Chhote dams aur recharge wells barish ka pani jama karte aur zer-e-zameen pani ki satah dobara bharte hain (33.7.2).

book_ref.quote: Constructing small dams and recharge wells helps store rainwater

blocks.text: 33.8 Rules and Regulations regarding Waste Pollution and Conservation

blocks.prompt:
107 Rules and regulations for water pollution control in Punjab are regularly issued by:
(Punjab mein water pollution control ke qawaid aur zawabit baqaidagi se kaun jaari karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Punjab Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) baqaidagi se mutaliqa qawaid jaari karti hai (33.8).

book_ref.quote: The Punjab Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Punjab regularly issues relevant rules

blocks.prompt:
108 Under the Punjab Environmental Protection Act, 1997, the penalty for non-compliance is:
(Punjab Environmental Protection Act, 1997 ke tehat khilaf warzi ki saza kya hai?)

options.text: Rs 5 million tak jurmana aur roz ka Rs 100,000 tak

blocks.explanation: Table 33.3: 1997 ke Act mein Rs 5 million tak jurmana aur roz ka Rs 100,000 tak izafi jurmana hai (33.8).

book_ref.quote: Fines up to Rs 5 million, plus additional daily fines of up to Rs 100,000.

blocks.prompt:
109 Which law prohibits discharging pollutants or blocking flow, with up to 3 months imprisonment and/or a Rs 500,000 fine?
(Kaun sa qanoon pollutants daalne ya bahao rokne ki mamanat karta hai, 3 maah tak qaid aur/ya Rs 500,000 jurmane ke saath?)

options.text: Punjab Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act, 2023
Punjab Water and Sanitation Authority Act, 2025

blocks.explanation: Table 33.3: Punjab Water Act, 2019 pollutants daalne ya bahao rokne ki mamanat karta hai (33.8).

book_ref.quote: Prohibits discharging pollutants or blocking flow.

blocks.prompt:
110 Which act establishes an Authority in major cities such as Lahore and Multan for integrated resource management and groundwater conservation?
(Kaun sa Act Lahore aur Multan jaise bare shehron mein mukammal resource management aur zer-e-zameen pani bachane ke liye Authority banata hai?)

options.text: Punjab Water and Sanitation Authority Act, 2025
Punjab Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act, 2023

blocks.explanation: Table 33.3: Punjab Water and Sanitation Authority Act, 2025 bare shehron mein Authority qaim karta hai (33.8).

book_ref.quote: Establishes the Authority in major cities (Lahore, Multan, etc.)

blocks.prompt:
111 The Punjab Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act, 2023:
(Punjab Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act, 2023 kya karta hai?)

options.text: leaded petrol par paabandi lagata hai
